Buenas noches. El playero del dia 25 de abril a la noche se nego a limpiarme los vidrios del auto, no habria problema si es un servicio que lugar no quiere brindar , pero la forma de contestar cuando amablemente le pregunte si se podia hacer fue que no porque se lo dije  despues de cargar , hay maneras y maneras , cargo nafta siempre en esta estacion me siento comodo una lastima tener que dejar de ir

(Translated by Google)
Good evening. The attendant on the evening of April 25th refused to clean my car windows. It wouldn't be a problem if it's a service the station doesn't want to offer, but the way he responded when I politely asked if it could be done was by saying no because I told him after filling up. There are ways and ways of doing things. I always fill up at this station; I feel comfortable there. It's a shame I have to stop going.
